label: 1. Telemetry, Storage & Alerts
info: Receives ESP32 Main Node & LoRa Gateway telemetry from Mosquitto (+/telemetry), pushes 1Hz live updates to WebSockets, writes throttled points (with immediate state-change override) to InfluxDB v2, and triggers edge-triggered Telegram + FCM browser push alerts.

label: 2. Dashboard REST API
info: Exposes REST endpoints for the Netlify frontend: /api/health, /api/latest, /api/history, /api/alerts, /api/fcm/register, /api/fcm/unregister, and /api/ota/trigger.

label: 3. Test & Simulation
info: Manual inject buttons for simulating States 0-4 over Mosquitto without physical ESP32 hardware.
